name: GPT-6 Astra
description: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's frontier model for complex agentic work, computer and browser use, software engineering, professional workflows, and scientific research. OpenAI describes Astra as its most aligned model to date and its first model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold. Initial access is limited while public API documentation and broader availability remain pending.
